Story: The Last Cake
One sunny morning, White Bunny brought a box of yummy carrot cakes to the Garden of Friends.
"Hey everyone! My mum baked cakes today. Let's eat them together!"
Brown Squirrel and Chubby Tiger ran over happily.
White Bunny opened the box.
"Wow! It smells so good!" cheered Brown Squirrel.
Each friend took a cake, eating and chatting happily.
Soon, there was only one cake left in the box.
Brown Squirrel looked at the last cake and gulped.
"I still want more! Can I have the last one?"
Just as Squirrel reached out, Chubby Tiger spoke up too:
"Hey, I want another one too!"
Both friends held on to the box.
"I saw it first!" said Brown Squirrel.
"But I want it too!" Chubby Tiger pouted.
Neither one would let go.
White Bunny looked at them and gently asked:
"If there is only one cake and you both want it, what can we do?"
Brown Squirrel thought for a moment:
"Maybe... break it in half?"
Chubby Tiger looked at the tiny cake:
"But then we only get half each!"
White Bunny smiled:
"That's right! But you both get to enjoy it!"
Chubby Tiger thought about it and nodded:
"Oh yes! That's better than one eating while the other just watches."
Brown Squirrel carefully broke the cake into two pieces.
But one piece was bigger than the other!
Brown Squirrel looked at the pieces and gave the bigger one to Chubby Tiger.
"You have this one!"
Chubby Tiger was surprised:
"Why didn't you take the big piece?"
Brown Squirrel laughed:
"Because you're bigger than me!"
Chubby Tiger burst out laughing:
"Ha ha! Thank you, Brown Squirrel!"
The two friends ate their cake together.
The last cake was all gone, but nobody was grumpy anymore.
Chubby Tiger rubbed his tummy:
"That cake was delicious!"
Brown Squirrel nodded:
"Yes! And eating with a friend is even more fun!"
White Bunny happily closed the empty box.
Outside, the sun was shining. The three friends held hands and ran to the playground.
From that day on, whenever they had something yummy, Squirrel and Tiger always asked:
"Shall we share it together?"
Today's lesson: Sharing is more fun!
